name: Princess Tears
original_name: プリンセスティアーズ
source:
The hero is a girl swordsman Elsie Istari. 
Because of the unavoidable circumstances, you will be forced to participate in a dangerous battle tournament in a big city. 
The purpose of the game is to defend her chastity from perverts who are like mountains and escape from the city safely.
translation:
英雄是一名女剑士，名叫埃尔茜·伊斯塔里。
由于不可避免的情况，你被迫参加大城市里危险的战斗锦标赛。
游戏目标是守护她的贞操，抵御山一样多的变态，并安全逃出城市。
